# Where do I download Census population data for my county?
1) Open your web browser and go to: https://data.census.gov

claims.objective: Open https://data.census.gov and check that the browser address bar shows "https://data.census.gov".

span.text: 2) Click the link labeled "Advanced Search" (top of the page).

claims.objective: Click the link labeled "Advanced Search" and confirm the page shows the link labeled "Advanced Search".

span.text: 3) Click "Geography".

claims.objective: Click "Geography" and confirm the page shows the link or tab labeled "Geography".

span.text: 4) In the geography chooser, click "County" (under the list of geography types).

claims.objective: In the geography chooser, click "County" and confirm the option "County" is shown.

span.text: 5) Click the drop-down labeled "State" and select your state (for example, "California").

claims.objective: Click the drop-down labeled "State" and select your state, then confirm the selected state shows the state name you chose (for example, "California").

span.text: 6) Click the drop-down labeled "County" and select your county (for example, "Los Angeles County").

claims.objective: Click the drop-down labeled "County" and select your county, then confirm the selected county shows the county name you chose (for example, "Los Angeles County").

span.text: 7) Click the blue button labeled "Update Search" (or "Done" if shown) to apply the geography.

claims.objective: Click the blue button labeled "Update Search" and confirm the button labeled "Update Search" was used.

span.text: 8) Back in Advanced Search, click "Surveys".

claims.objective: In Advanced Search, click "Surveys" and confirm the control labeled "Surveys" is visible.

span.text: 9) Select the survey you want:
- For current multi-year estimates choose "ACS 5-Year Estimates".

claims.objective: Select "ACS 5-Year Estimates" and confirm the survey selection shows "ACS 5-Year Estimates".

span.text: - For the official population count from the 2020 Census choose "Decennial Census".

claims.objective: Select "Decennial Census" and confirm the survey selection shows "Decennial Census".

span.text: 10) Click "Topics".

claims.objective: Click "Topics" and confirm the control labeled "Topics" is visible.

span.text: 11) In Topics, type and select "B01003: Total population" (or type "population" and choose the topic/table labeled "Total Population" or "B01003: Total Population").

claims.objective: In Topics, type and select "B01003: Total population" and confirm the selection shows "B01003: Total population".

span.text: 12) Click the blue button labeled "Search" (top-right).

claims.objective: Click the blue button labeled "Search" and confirm the button labeled "Search" was clicked.

span.text: 13) In the search results, click the table titled "B01003: TOTAL POPULATION" (or the specific table name that appears for the selected survey).

claims.objective: In the search results, click the table titled "B01003: TOTAL POPULATION" and confirm the table title "B01003: TOTAL POPULATION" is shown.

span.text: 14) On the table page, confirm the geography in the header shows your county.

claims.objective: On the table page, check the header to confirm it shows your county.

span.text: 15) Click the button labeled "Download" (usually at the upper-right of the table).

claims.objective: Click the button labeled "Download" and confirm the button labeled "Download" is visible.

span.text: 16) In the Download dialog, choose format "CSV" (or "CSV / Excel") and click the blue button labeled "Download" (or "Download Data").

claims.objective: In the Download dialog, choose format "CSV" and confirm the format option labeled "CSV" is selected.

span.text: 17) Save the CSV file when prompted — it will contain the population for the selected county.

claims.objective: Save the CSV file when prompted and confirm the file was saved.

span.text:
Notes:
- If you need yearly estimates for multiple years, in Advanced Search use "Year" to pick a specific ACS year before searching.
- If you want a quick single value without table details, search the data.census.gov search box (top) for "County Name population" and open the relevant result, then use "Download".
